title: Distro
tagline: Distro fixes clipping marketplaces to give brands and builders more reach with crypto infra.
description:
Distro fixes clipping marketplaces. We use crypto to make them work the way they should. Brands and builders reach more people, and clippers actually get paid for the views they bring in.

Step 1 - Brands fund a pool. A brand puts USDC in a pool and drops in the content they want clipped.

Step 2 - Clippers cut it up. Clippers turn it into short videos for YouTube, TikTok, and X.

Step 3 - Reach gets paid. Every thousand real views pays out from the pool, in USDC.
how_its_made:
I built a monorepo with the following approach:
- App = Next.js
- Contracts = Foundry (using Arc)
- API = NestJS
- CRE = Special Chainlink Runtime Environment setup to trigger jobs manually or on a daily cron.

Bot gated by WorldID. Onchain/offchain view reconciliation via Chainlink CRE. Privy wallet integrated. Payment rails on Arc.
auto_summary: A monorepo for a clipping marketplace that verifies users with World ID, tracks video views via Chainlink CRE, and pays clip creators from onchain escrow.
